Presidential elections are set to be held on November 4, 2068, to elect the president and vice president of the United States. The winner of this election will be inaugurated on January 20, 2065. Voters in each state and the District of Columbia will choose electors to the Electoral College, who will then elect a president and vice president for a term of four years.
The presidential election will take place at the same time as elections for the U.S. Senate, House, gubernatorial, and state legislatures.
